v2_status: manual addition (v2)
manual_change_note: ADD coal retirement: Unit 2 ceased coal burn end-Dec 2025 (WA law / 2011 TransAlta MOA; last coal burned Dec 2025, zero generation since). DOE FPA 202(c) emergency orders hold it available as coal through Dec 12, 2026, so the retirement is booked Dec 2026 at the anchor boundary (cf. MISO v2 Belle River). EIA carries no planned retirement for the unit.

status: manual addition (v2)
source_sheet: TransAlta-PSE tolling agreement Dec 9, 2025; SEPA MDNS Jul 31, 2026
v2_status: manual addition (v2)
manual_change_note: ADD gas (fuel switch): 16-year fixed-price tolling agreement with Puget Sound Energy (signed Dec 9, 2025) converts Unit 2 to natural gas; 700 MW contracted capacity, 723 MW maximum net per the SEPA MDNS; ~$600m capex; target COD late 2028 (booked Dec 2028); FID expected early 2027 after WUTC approval; operates to end-2044. Booked at the EIA nameplate 729.9 MW (stack basis is nameplate; cf. MISO v2 fuel switches, which kept nameplate unchanged).

source_sheet: BPA approval of EPU implementation, May 2025
v2_status: manual addition (v2)
manual_change_note: ADD (uprate): Extended Power Uprate +186 MW (162 MW EPU + 24 MW energy-efficiency upgrades), ~$700m, approved for implementation by BPA May 2025 after 18 months of analysis. Staged across the 2027/2029/2031 refuelling outages (~30 modifications); booked at completion, Dec 2031. NRC licence amendment request to be submitted 2028. Plant licensed through 2043; subsequent licence renewal planned. Not in the EIA Planned sheet. (Operator states current output 1,207 MW vs EIA nameplate 1,200.0 MW; the uprate increment is unaffected.)
